#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, h;
    std::cin >> n >> h;

    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> node_height_array(36, std::vector<long long>(36, 0));
    node_height_array[0][0] = 1;

    for (int total_nodes = 1; total_nodes < 36; ++total_nodes) {
        for (int min_height = 0; min_height <= total_nodes; ++min_height) {
            for (int root_node = 1; root_node <= total_nodes; ++root_node) {
                int left_subtree_size = root_node - 1;
                int right_subtree_size = total_nodes - root_node;

                long long left_zero = node_height_array[left_subtree_size][0];
                long long right_zero = node_height_array[right_subtree_size][0];

                int max_min_height = std::max(min_height - 1, 0);

                long long left_subtree = left_zero - node_height_array[left_subtree_size][max_min_height];
                long long right_subtree = right_zero - node_height_array[right_subtree_size][max_min_height];

                node_height_array[total_nodes][min_height] +=
                    left_zero * right_zero - left_subtree * right_subtree;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << static_cast<int>(node_height_array[n][h]) << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
